items.name: Footprints
items.text: This tunnel needs two Boots instead of one.

items.name: Monster
items.text: Moving through deals you one damage for each Monster icon. Each Sword you spend prevents the damage from one icon. You do not have to use Swords.

items.name: Lock
items.text: You cannot use this tunnel unless you spend a Lockpick: place it on the icon. The tunnel is unlocked for everyone for the rest of the game. Two Lock icons in one tunnel (on two tiles) cost two Lockpicks.

items.name: One-way
items.text: An arrow-shaped tunnel can only be used in the direction of the arrow. Teleporting ignores this; the Catacombs Map major secret lets you go against it.

items.name: Portal
items.text: A tunnel ending in a portal: you do not stop there, you exit from any other portal on any tile. The whole move (room, both portals, next room) costs one Boot and follows normal tunnel rules. You may keep moving afterwards.

items.name: Artifact room
items.text: When you first place a tile with an Artifact room, take the top Artifact from the Bank and put it there. Pick it up with the Take an Artifact action (at any point in your turn); the Dragon marker moves up one space. Once the stack is empty you find nothing.

items.name: Artifact + / ++
items.text: Place the Artifact one (+) or two (++) down from the top of the stack instead of the top one. If fewer remain below the top, place the highest-valued Artifact that remains.

items.name: Crypt
items.text: The room you start in, on the starting tile, above the dungeon. Returning here with an Artifact is how you escape: finish your turn, remove your pawn, take a Mastery token (+20). You cannot return empty-handed.

items.name: Crystal Cave
items.text: Entering exhausts you: no more Boots for the rest of the turn. Teleport still works, but you stay exhausted. Crystal Kobolds can only be fought here (or in a Wayshrine).

items.name: Haunted tile
items.text: Four of the 22 Depths tiles carry a ghost mark. When you add one to the dungeon, take a Ghost cube from the Bank and put it in the Clank! area; it joins the Dragon Bag at the next attack and hurts everyone when drawn.

items.name: Chest
items.text: Locked feature. While in the room, spend a Lockpick to cover the Chest and take a random major secret from the Bank. Not possible when no major secrets remain. Each feature can be picked once per game.

items.name: Library
items.text: Locked feature. While in the room, spend a Lockpick to cover the Library and acquire a Secret Tome from the Reserve into your discard pile, for free. Not possible when no Secret Tomes remain.

items.name: Prison
items.text: Locked feature. While in the room, spend a Lockpick to cover the Prison and free two Prisoners: take two random Prisoner tokens face up into your supply (keep them for scoring). Not possible when no Prisoners remain; one remaining can still be freed.

items.name: Market
items.text: While in a Market room you may buy any item on the Market Board for 7 Gold each, as often as you can pay: Backpack, Blood Amulet, Burglar's Kit, Crown.

items.name: Wayshrine
items.text: While here, once per Wayshrine and as a special action, place a cube from your supply on an empty space around it and take 1 Gold for every Wayshrine you have marked this game (1, then 2, then 3...). Needs a cube in your supply; those cubes never become Clank!. Four spaces per Wayshrine.

items.name: Monkey Shrine
items.text: On the starting tile. The three Monkey Idols sit here at setup; entering the room takes one (5 points, not an Artifact).

items.name: Minor secret
items.text: Reward room. Entering gives one random minor secret from the Bank, revealed at once. Rewards come once per turn per room; re-enter on a later turn for another. No reward when the Bank is empty.

items.name: Monkey Idol
items.text: Reward room. Take one Monkey Idol from the room into your personal supply (5 points at the end).

items.name: Gold
items.text: Reward room. Take the amount of Gold shown from the Bank, once per turn per room.

items.name: Healing
items.text: Reward room. Heal 1 damage: take a cube of your colour back from your Health Meter into your supply. Once per turn per room.

items.name: Start A, top
items.text: The upper half of the starting tile is in the Depths (you score 0 if knocked out there). Shown here: Wayshrine, Monkey Shrine, tunnels with Monster icons.

items.name: Start A, bottom
items.text: The Crypt (start and escape room), a reward room and a Crystal Cave behind locked tunnels. Tiles placed along the long edges line up with either the top or the bottom half.

items.name: Start B, top
items.text: The other side of the starting tile; either side may be used. Its upper half is in the Depths too.

items.name: Start B, bottom
items.text: Side B, lower half, with the Crypt.
